forwardRepairPlan.exactAuthorizationDeclarationTemplate:
## Mixed Protected-Path Atomicity Authorization

Disposition: AUTHORIZED_EXACT_MANIFEST
Atomicity reason: baseline and work-order status changes alter currentAuthority raw hashes, which must regenerate core, state and bootstrap in the same commit.
Rollback boundary: revert only this closure commit; preserve M1, original failed range evidence and adjudications.
Exact changed manifest: <every C1 path in backticks, including the host review itself>.
authorizationRules: section lives in a file that build_path_plan detects as a trace artifact (contains '## Agent Operation Trace Block' and 'Actual changed set') and is a .md
the four literal tokens must appear: 'Disposition: AUTHORIZED_EXACT_MANIFEST', 'Atomicity reason:', 'Rollback boundary:', 'Exact changed manifest:'

every changed path, including paths from git status of a dirty tree and the host file, must appear as `path` inside the section (up to the next '## ' heading); a single omission or extra changed path fails
generic EXCEPTION_WITH_REASON prose does not authorize
the check reads the working-tree file, so commit exactly the bytes that were checked and keep the tree clean
atomicHashRegenerationOrder: 1. Freeze baseline, work order, completion review text including the authorization section and Agent Operation Trace manifest (9 paths).
2. Compute sha256 of the on-disk raw bytes (CRLF on this Windows checkout) of the baseline and the work order; never use git show or blob hashes.

3. Write baselineSha256 and workOrderSha256 into CVF_SESSION/state/ACTIVE_SESSION_STATE_CORE.json currentAuthority, then run python -B governance/compat/generate_active_session_state.py --generate and --check.
4. Update handoff HEAD marker, CVF_SESSION_MEMORY.md and nextAllowedMove.json; do not touch the baseline or work order afterward (any later edit invalidates step 2).
5. Re-run steps 2 and check_active_session_state.py --enforce; stage the exact 9 paths with an explicit list (no add -A).
